sloka: यदिदं ममम् दुःखाय शेशे क्ल्याणि पांसुषु ।भूमौ शेषे किमर्थं त्वं मयि कल्याणचेतसि ।भूतोपहतचित्तेव मम चित्तप्रमाथिनी ॥२-१०-२९॥
transliteration: yadidaṁ mamam duḥkhāya śeśe klyāṇi pāṁsuṣu ।bhūmau śeṣe kimarthaṁ tvaṁ mayi kalyāṇacetasi ।bhūtopahatacitteva mama cittapramāthinī ॥2-10-29॥

translations.english: While I am here favourably disposed towards you, why are you lying down on the floor like one possessed by an evil spirit? Why are you afflicting my mind?
